tagline: Athens' calm-water gulf — car-free islands, daily commuter and tourist hops, and a superyacht marina cluster.
summary: The Saronic Gulf is Athens' sheltered front yard: Hydra (entirely car-free), Aegina, Poros and Spetses are daily ferry and hydrofoil destinations minutes-to-an-hour from the Athenian Riviera marinas (Flisvos, Alimos, Marina Zeas). The gulf's calmer water and short, dense legs make it an ideal Pioneer II commuter-and-tourism corridor, and Athens' marina cluster is one of the Med's largest superyacht bases.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the entire Saronic Gulf — Hydra (~35 nm), Aegina (~17 nm), Poros (~27 nm), Spetses — plus the Athenian Riviera coastal commute and marina tenders.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) links the Saronic to the Cyclades and the Peloponnese.

competitive_landscape: Hellenic Seaways and Saronic ferries run today (demand proof), alongside a large superyacht marina cluster. Hydra's car-free status is a uniquely clean fit. No foiling incumbent.
seasonality: Less extreme than the open Aegean — the gulf is sheltered and shoulder-season viable, though tourism still peaks May–Sep.
regulatory_note: Greek flag / EU; Hellenic Coast Guard; Marina Zeas/Flisvos/Alimos are concessioned marinas. Athenian Riviera redevelopment (Ellinikon) is a major waterfront catalyst.

precedents.why_it_matters: Saronic mirrors a sheltered metro-gulf with daily commuter + tourist mix.
